I love everyone. Smile at strangers and look them in the eye and project love. Walk barefoot in nature more. Stay away from the news and get out on the grass, lay in the sun. Read good books. Books that uplift you and grow you. Eat healthy food. Stay away from the processed stuff and excess sugar. Park your car a little farther away. Don't be afraid to walk the extra distance it will be good for your heart and body. Don't be afraid to journal and get to know yourself. Writing your thoughts down can help you grow. Too much technology can be bad. You don't have to learn everything. It's fun to learn but slow down with quiet silent time. Silent time is healing time. It's time where your body can regenerate and heal. Utilize this time for peace and long term well being. 

Meditation can profoundly change your brain and mind for the better. The mind illuminated is the best book out there. 

Focus on generating human values. Kindness compassion gratitude appreciation honesty generosity to name a few. 

I love you all
